title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.02201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. While effective, this design fragments continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflates generation cost, and often weakens topological consistency for thin or highly connected shapes. We introduce SILSA, a topology-aware 3D generation framework that represents shapes with compact sliding-window slice latents. Instead of generating expensive voxel tokens, SILSA uses a fixed set of overlapping slices along the three canonical axes, where each token summarizes a local depth window to preserve cross-sectional continuity and support single-stage rectified-flow generation. translated_title: SILSA：用于保持拓扑结构的高分辨率3D生成的滑动窗口切片潜在表示
translated_abstract: 高分辨率3D生成日益依赖于体素潜在表示和多阶段流水线，即先预测活跃结构、再合成局部几何。虽然有效，但这种设计会将连续表面碎片化为大量局部标记，推高了生成成本，并且常常削弱了细薄或高度连接形状的拓扑一致性。我们提出了SILSA，这是一种拓扑感知的3D生成框架，采用紧凑的滑动窗口切片潜在表示来表征形状。SILSA不生成昂贵的体素标记，而是使用沿三个规范轴分布的一组固定重叠切片，其中每个标记总结一个局部深度窗口，以保持横截面连续性并支持单阶段整流流生成。切片VAE将有向表面样本编码为多轴切片潜在表示，并通过稀疏体积解码器进行重建，同时体积锚点晶格协调各方向的切片流……
tldr: SILSA提出了一种拓扑感知的3D生成框架，用固定的重叠滑动窗口切片潜在表示替代昂贵的体素标记，保持横截面连续性并支持单阶段整流流生成，从而在高分辨率3D生成中更好地保持拓扑一致性。
en_tdlr: SILSA is a topology-aware 3D generation framework that replaces expensive voxel tokens with compact sliding-window slice latents along three canonical axes, preserving cross-sectional continuity and enabling single-stage rectified-flow generation for topology-preserving high-resolution 3D shapes.
